boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented University of Iowa study environments, from reservable collaboration rooms to quiet library seating.

cards.title: Main Library Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Main Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up at a movable table or lounge seat, then use the nearby Just Ask Desk for a weekday drop-in research consultation.
cards.short_summary: Flexible first-floor seating with academic help and technology resources nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: The first-floor Learning Commons has lounge seating, movable tables, electrical outlets, reservable rooms, and a research-help desk.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons — University of Iowa Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Main Library; consult the library’s current open-hours listing before visiting.

cards.title: Learning Commons Group Spaces
cards.subtitle: Main Library, first-floor Learning Commons
cards.notes: Reserve online for a project session with at least one other student; plan for a two-hour maximum and claim the room on time.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms for collaborative work in the Main Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Learning Commons group spaces are reservable by students, require groups of two or more, and allow reservations of up to two hours.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons group spaces — University of Iowa Libraries
cards.access_notes: Student reservations use Office 365, HealthcareOWA, or room touchscreens; unclaimed reservations are forfeited after 10 minutes.

cards.entity_name: Main Library Undergraduate Short-Term Study Rooms
cards.title: Undergraduate Short-Term Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Main Library
cards.notes: Bring your Iowa One Card to the first-floor Service Desk and request a key when you need a solo, short-term workspace.
cards.short_summary: Individual rooms for current undergraduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Current UI undergraduates may use individual Main Library rooms on a first-come, first-served basis for four-hour short-term study.
cards.source_title: Main Library study spaces and locker information — University of Iowa Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available when Main Library collections are open; one undergraduate per room, with a key collected and returned at the Service Desk.

cards.entity_name: Third-Floor Current and Bound Journals Quiet Seating
cards.title: Third-Floor Journal Seating
cards.subtitle: Main Library, east side of third floor
cards.notes: Choose a seat around the current and bound journals for individual work, and keep conversation to a whisper if needed.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet zone among the Main Library’s journal collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The east side of the Main Library’s third floor around current and bound journals is designated quiet study seating.
cards.source_title: Main Library study spaces and locker information — University of Iowa Libraries
cards.access_notes: This is a quiet-study area: whispered conversations and individual work are permitted.

cards.title: Fourth-Floor Bookstacks Seating
cards.subtitle: Main Library, east and west bookstacks
cards.notes: Head to either bookstack side on the fourth floor when you want individual work in a designated quiet-study area.
cards.short_summary: Quiet seating tucked into the Main Library’s fourth-floor stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Both the east and west bookstack areas on the Main Library’s fourth floor are designated quiet study seating.
cards.source_title: Main Library study spaces and locker information — University of Iowa Libraries
cards.access_notes: Quiet-study expectations apply: individual work is permitted and conversations should be whispered.

cards.title: Fifth-Floor Bookstacks Seating
cards.subtitle: Main Library, east and west bookstacks
cards.notes: Use a fifth-floor stack-side seat for a quiet individual session, keeping calls and regular conversation in the central corridors.
cards.short_summary: A second quiet bookstack setting on the Main Library’s upper floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Both the east and west bookstack areas on the Main Library’s fifth floor are designated quiet study seating.
cards.source_title: Main Library study spaces and locker information — University of Iowa Libraries
cards.access_notes: Quiet-study expectations apply; the library directs phone calls and conversations to central corridors.

cards.entity_name: Lichtenberger Engineering Library Pod 1 and Pod 2
cards.title: Engineering Library Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Lichtenberger Engineering Library
cards.notes: Reserve a pod with your HawkID for a small-group session; use the Solstice display to share a laptop, tablet, or phone screen.
cards.short_summary: Two small reservable rooms built for screen-sharing collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Pod 1 and Pod 2 each seat four to five people and include Solstice wireless-collaboration technology.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms — Lichtenberger Engineering Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve through Office 365 using a HawkID; the library’s group-space rules and current hours apply.

cards.title: Engineering Library Creative Space
cards.subtitle: Lichtenberger Engineering Library
cards.notes: Bring a larger project group to the movable tables and whiteboards, and check whether a workshop has the space in use first.
cards.short_summary: A flexible project room with large monitors, whiteboards, and maker equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Engineering Library Creative Space has large monitors, whiteboards, movable tables, and is first-come, first-served for students when not closed for workshops.
cards.source_title: Find a study space — Lichtenberger Engineering Library
cards.access_notes: Open to students on a first-come, first-served basis; it may be unavailable during workshops.

cards.entity_name: Lichtenberger Engineering Library Lower-Level Silent Study
cards.title: Engineering Library Lower-Level Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Lichtenberger Engineering Library, lower level
cards.notes: Take a carrel, armchair, beanbag, or gaming chair downstairs when you need a silent setting with power for your equipment.
cards.short_summary: Silent lower-level seating with carrels and varied chair options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Engineering Library’s downstairs level is silent study space with carrels, armchairs, beanbag chairs, and gaming chairs.
cards.source_title: Find a study space — Lichtenberger Engineering Library
cards.access_notes: The source distinguishes this silent lower level from the main floor, where talking is allowed.

cards.title: Hubbard Commons
cards.subtitle: Iowa Memorial Union
cards.notes: Settle near the fireplace for an individual study block, then use IMU WiFi or move to an ITC if you need a campus computer.
cards.short_summary: Fireplace-adjacent IMU seating with WiFi and nearby computing options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Iowa Memorial Union identifies Hubbard Commons as a fireplace-side study setting and offers WiFi, ITCs, and additional tables and couches.
cards.access_notes: The IMU states that a HawkID is required for ITCs and wireless internet; check current building hours before visiting.
